notes.title: The café is open — Demo V2 is here
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172021/14369a8adb628ec0c48063978b2c4f0d89625343.png"]

The café doors are open once again.

The Coffee Talk Tokyo Demo V2 is now live, serving up new things:

• Day 1 in full – experience the entire first night in Tokyo
• A sneak peek of Day 2 – a glimpse of what’s brewing next
• Expanded language support – now fully localized in 9 languages: English, Japanese, German, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean
• Available now on Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox
(Nintendo Switch demo is planned for a later date)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172021/1471bd1650509a83f8f21943bfeaac7d17a767ab.gif"]

Set in a neon-lit Tokyo summer, Coffee Talk Tokyo is a cozy narrative adventure where humans and fantastical beings gather to share their stories. As the barista, you’ll brew drinks to warm their hearts and guide their conversations through meaningful choices.



Play the Demo Today

The Demo V2 is free to play starting now. Download it, take your first sip of what’s next, and don’t forget to add Coffee Talk Tokyo to your wishlist to stay updated.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172021/4544c953f9d41a8ac37bb8e1c4037125faed8c98.png"]

💡 Discover the full Coffee Talk universe on our Franchise Page: 

https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45691194



Follow the series to get future updates and explore past stories. 

Thank you for your continued support of Coffee Talk Tokyo.

notes.title: Devlog #1 – Demo V2 Coming Soon
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172021/3a26cc604865f2ea4b5f91c914e7a155f63e7973.jpg"]A late-night digital refuge, now in Tokyo.
When we began working on Coffee Talk Tokyo, we knew we weren’t just continuing a series. We were building a new home.
A place where people could slow down, open up, and find warmth in rainy nights and unexpected conversations.

Our new café is set in a version of Tokyo that feels both grounded and dreamy: neon-lit alleys, familiar silhouettes, a gentle pace.
But the heart of Coffee Talk remains unchanged. Stories shared over a hot drink, told at your rhythm.
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for the warm welcome

In the past two months, over 50,000 players have added Coffee Talk Tokyo to their wishlists. That’s a milestone we’re deeply grateful for.
Whether you’re a longtime fan or just discovering the series, thank you for stepping into our café and sharing your thoughts.
We’ve already seen beautiful feedback, creative theories, and one big question: what’s next?
[hr][/hr]
What’s next: Demo V2 is coming soon

We’re brewing a new, expanded version of the demo. A deeper taste of the full experience.
It will include:

The full Episode 1 (Day 1)

A first look at Episode 2 (Day 2)

Full localization in Brazilian Portuguese, plus Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, and Spanish

New polish and balance updates based on your feedback

This new demo will go live at the end of August.

If you enjoyed the current demo, we’d love to welcome you back for seconds. And if you’re new here, there’s always a seat waiting for you.
[hr][/hr]
Wishlist Coffee Talk Tokyo

Every wishlist helps our small team reach more players.
If you’d like to support us, just hit the green button and stay tuned for what’s coming next.

Let’s keep the conversation going.
The Coffee Talk Tokyo team
